pro_course_detail.description:

I teach both employers and employees on how to become effective communicators in the workplace. In my classes will cover topics such as:

✔ how to develop and express your ideas clearly and confidently
 ✔ persuasive communication
✔ different types of communication styles
✔ polite communication

✔ avoiding miscommunication

✔ negotiations (how to achieve a win-win solution)

Through practical activities and customized lessons, you will be equipped with the relevant vocabulary, idioms, and functional language to effectively communicate in your unique business setting. Expect to speak confidently and clearly after these lessons. All your progress will be measurable. 

The phrasal verbs that you will learn in the lessons will set you apart in any conversation. Pronunciation will also be emphasized during these lessons. As part of their continual learning, I also send short podcasts that my students can listen to. This will further increase their vocabulary and improve their fluency.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational fluency for adults
pro_course_detail.description:
This course is for professionals and leaders who want to improve their conversational skills and overall fluency when discussing business topics. 

The topics are based on self-development and designed to improve both your communication skills and career. Every topic is based on a business article from reputable websites such as Harvard Business Review (HBR) and Forbes. 

Some topics include: 

✔How to increase your influence in the workplace
✔How to build a personal brand at work
✔Understanding your communication style 
✔ The power of morning and evening rituals
✔ Job redesign
✔ 7Cs of communication
✔ Performance punishment
✔ Ageism in the workplace
✔ 6 thinking hats

A real conversation involves speaking, listening, asking questions and commenting on answers. To become a fluent English speaker, your brain and your mouth need to work together. I will show you how you can practically do this! All you need is some motivation, creativity, and good habits. All my conversation classes are based on real life situations. You will learn how to confidently express your ideas in a conversation.

I will help build your vocabulary and speaking confidence. You will overcome any fear you have of speaking English with another person. 

The lessons will be conducted in a relaxed environment where you will be able to acquire the relevant words and phrases necessary for effective communication. Every conversational lesson is based on an interesting topic. I will send materials to you before the class so that you become familiar with the topic. In this way, you will have more speaking practice during the lesson. See you in class! 

As part of their continual learning, I also send short podcasts that my students can listen to. This will further increase their vocabulary and improve their fluency.

pro_course_detail.title: Job Interview Preparation
pro_course_detail.description:
I have successfully prepared and helped professionals in the following types of interviews and industries: 

✔ Aviation interviews (both pilots and cabin crews) 
✔ Amazon interviews
✔ Software Engineers
✔ HR-related jobs
✔ Finance and auditing
✔ College entrance interviews
✔ Residency interviews

Success stories: I recently helped a few of my students pass their job interviews. They will now be starting new jobs with higher salaries and greater job satisfaction. (*Please check my reviews for success stories*)

Please note: It takes about 6-8 hours to prepare for a job interview depending on your English level. 

In these interactive classes, you will be introduced to all the language and strategies that you need to stand out in your interview. You will learn how to answer:

✔ "Tell me about yourself"
✔ Behavioral questions (TMAAT)
✔ Competency questions
✔ Describe your education and experience
✔ Soft skills questions
✔ General interview questions 

A successful interview requires you to tell a unique story about your skills, achievements, qualifications, and personality. I have helped many students pass their job interviews. A successful job interview is one where you are able to differentiate yourself from other candidates. 

This requires preparation, fluency, and confidence. You will be prepared to answer both common and unexpected questions in the interview. You will learn about the power words, verbs, and phrases that you need to use in your interview. You will be able to apply time-tested strategies to help effectively answer every question that is posed to you. You will learn to speak in a way that sounds "clean" and "clear". I also offer a CV-checking service as well.

pro_course_detail.title: Accents, Pronunciation, and Spelling
pro_course_detail.description:
Did you know that there are 44 sounds (known as phonemes) in the English language? There are also a number of pronunciation differences between American English, British English, and English spoken in specific countries.

If you really want to focus on being better understood in English, to sound more fluent, to improve your spelling, and to improve your listening skills in English, then this is the class for you! 

In this class the following areas will be covered:

-Pronunciation, accent, and word differences that you are likely to hear in New Zealand, Australia, Britain and the USA. 

-Word stress and syllables
Sometimes when we learn a new language, it can be hard to hear what syllable or letter we need to emphasise in a word, or sentence. When we emphasise the wrong part of a word, or sentence, it can completely change the way a word / sentence sounds.

-Mouth Shape / Tongue Placement
Often we don't think about, or know where our tongue needs to be, in relation to different parts of the mouth. This is quite important for achieving particular sounds in any language. For example the 'th' sound in English requires the tongue to pass between our front teeth for a brief moment. This part of the lesson will cover techniques to help you to achieve those difficult sounds that you may not have in your own native language.

-Spelling in English
 Words are not written as they sound in English. This part of the class focuses on how to recognise words in their written form, and how to match the sounds with the spelling. For example, some of the words that we will discuss in this class are: through, though, thought, words with silent letters, such as: knight, night, knife, island, and words ending in the letter, 'y', such as: sky, fly, buy, etc....

I look forward to helping you improve in these specific areas.

Book your lesson today!

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Preparation
pro_course_detail.description:
These lessons are designed to assist you as you prepare for your IELTS examination.

You will have the opportunity to practise the individual skills that you need the most help with, (reading, writing, listening, or speaking) in each lesson. There will be question and answer time during each lesson.

PACKAGED LESSON STRUCTURE

*Lesson 1_IELTS Introduction / Overview
General Training vs Academic; band score and marking criteria; create a study action plan; test format; question formats; areas of concern.

-Lesson 2_SPEAKING
*Understanding the IELTS Speaking question formats; marking criteria; practice tests; interesting vocabulary worksheets; how to sound more fluent; tips to help overcome the fear of making mistakes when speaking; pronunciation; error feedback; questions and concerns.

-Lesson 3_LISTENING
*Understanding the IELTS Listening question formats; marking criteria; practice tests; discussing the sub skills of listening (prediction, listening for gist vs listening for detail); sounds; error feedback; questions and concerns.

-Lesson 4_READING 
*Understanding the IELTS Reading question formats; marking criteria; practice tests; discussing the sub skills of reading (prediction, reading for gist vs reading for detail); new vocabulary meaning, form, and pronunciation; error feedback; questions and concerns.

-Lesson 5_WRITING Overview
*Understanding the IELTS Writing question formats; marking criteria; practice tests; simple, compound, and complex sentences; writing structures; how to organise your ideas logically; punctuation, spelling tips, error feedback; questions and concerns.

-Lesson 6_WRITING: ESSAYS & LETTERS
*Understanding your audience;  informal vs formal; correct collocation of interesting vocabulary; how to start and finish well; logical flow of ideas.

*Lessons 7-10_SPECIFIC SKILLS
-These lessons will be tailored to your specific needs: reading, writing, speaking, or listening. They will also cover exam time management.

Feel free to come to the lesson with a list of your own words you struggle pronouncing and/or articulating and we will tackle these words together.

pro_course_detail.title: Crafting and Delivering Powerful Speeches
pro_course_detail.description:
Objective:
By the end of this lesson, students will have the skills to write a compelling speech, focusing on structure, tone, and persuasive language, and practice delivering it with confidence and clarity.

Lesson Overview:
This lesson is designed to guide students through the process of writing and delivering an impactful speech. We will focus on understanding the key components of a speech, including the introduction, body, and conclusion. Students will explore techniques for engaging an audience, such as the use of storytelling, rhetorical devices, and strong, clear messaging. After crafting their speeches, students will practice delivering them, receiving feedback on their delivery style, body language, and voice modulation.
